parameters.content:
## A message to a real person is a HIGH-risk action

The governance service classifies `action_type: send` as HIGH, which means a
human approves every outreach before it leaves. That is the default on purpose.
An operator who wants unattended sending lowers it to `write` by passing a
different `governance_action_type`, and that choice is recorded on every row of
the outreach log.

Nothing reaches the gate until the deterministic copy rules and the verifier
have both passed. A draft with a fabricated figure is refused locally and never
becomes a question for a human.

parameters.jsCode:
const raw = $input.first().json;
const r = (raw && raw.json) ? raw.json : raw;
const fx = $("Outreach Fixture Loop").first().json;
const ruleNames = ((r.copy || {}).issues || []).map(function (i) { return i.rule; });
return [{ json: {
  case_id: fx.case_id,
  note: fx.note,
  expect_status: fx.expect_status,
  expect_stage: fx.expect_stage,
  expect_decision: fx.expect_decision,
  expect_risk: fx.expect_risk,
  expect_rule: fx.expect_rule,
  expect_trace: fx.trace_id,
  actual_status: r.delivery_status,
  actual_stage: r.blocked_stage,
  actual_decision: (r.governance || {}).decision,
  actual_risk: (r.governance || {}).risk_level,
  tenant_id: r.tenant_id,
  trace_id: r.trace_id,
  copy_rules_hit: ruleNames,
  sent: r.sent,
  draft: String(r.draft || "").slice(0, 300),
  word_count: r.word_count,
  copy_score: (r.copy || {}).score,
  verified: (r.verification || {}).verified,
  draft_source: (r.provenance || {}).draft_source,
  model_provider: (r.provenance || {}).model_provider,
  latency_ms: r.latency_ms
} }];

parameters.content:
## Outreach suite

Ten fixtures, one for each place a send can be stopped: the qualification refused
it, the copy rules caught it, verification could not support it, or a human said
no. Every case asserts `sent: false`, because the suite runs with `dry_run=true`
and nothing it does can reach a real inbox.

O09 is deliberate. A draft offering to "delete the manual steps" is escalated to
CRITICAL by the governance service and denied, because the risk scan reads the
draft as well as the operation. That is a false positive, and the system prefers
it to the alternative.

description: Drafts one outreach message, checks it deterministically against copy rules and the evidence, verifies it, and only then asks Governance. action_type send is HIGH risk, so a human approves every real send by default.
